How these tables work

The model uses actual EX scores to estimate scoring ability from overlapping players. Each goal then has its own fitted achievement curve, chart difficulty estimates, and sorted folders. AAA means EX/max ≥ 8/9. MAX− here means EX/max ≥ 17/18, the common 94.44% milestone—not beatoraja’s separately named 26/27 target.

Stages follow approximately equal ability steps, with boundaries nudged toward nearby gaps. The sparse upper tail uses gradually wider steps. There is no chart-count target and no A/B subdivision. Bounds include the lower value and exclude the upper value. Values on individual rows are rounded.

These are historical PB rankings. Repeated practice, old scores, input devices and individual strengths can affect them. Plays/player is an exposure indicator, not a correction. Provisional means weak evidence, not a precise ordering. Independent target models may occasionally cross on weakly supported charts.

For game import, use the URL shown for the selected goal. This site’s root URL imports its 98% stages; the links above open separate pages whose addresses can be imported directly.
